linkedin.text:
Most corporate retreats are conferences with better scenery. The agenda is still full, the days still start at eight, and people come home having rested exactly not at all.

This is a quiet cove on a programme we produced. It was chosen for one reason: there is nowhere to be.

If the goal is genuine recovery — after a hard year, a merger, a period of sustained overtime — the design rules are different. Sessions in the morning only. No evening programme on at least two nights. Rooms that are actually quiet. And crucially, leadership visibly doing the same thing, because a team will not switch off while the executives are on laptops in the lobby.

The hardest part is not the venue. It is holding the line on the agenda when someone suggests adding just one more session.

If your team needs restoring rather than motivating in 2026, say so in the brief and we will build for that instead.

Uproduction Events — From Business to Pleasure

📩 alon@upe.co.il
